Recover the run-owned unlock-rule portion of originaled573ba, stacked on #98.

```text
new run → source52-ID reset list
upgrade tier → append missing IDs in source order
lower/repeated tier → retain the same unlock snapshot
palette / save rules → optional authoritative list; current budgets still apply
```

World ownership and editor/viewer propagation follow in separate slices.

- Independent primary-source audit confirms the exact52 reset IDs and all six ordered tier appends, reaching92 unique IDs. Source reset omits constructor-only hidden7001; downgrades remove none.

- Full profile/cheat behavior, runtime wiring and synchronized original-game parity remain outstanding.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert removes the unused history owner and optional policy inputs.

**Blast Radius:** rules

Palette/save membership APIs; affordability and current class/GP/BP constraints remain unchanged.

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores level-only offer filtering.

World-owned membership and upgrade offers; damage/restore calculations and current budgets remain unchanged.
